_note: Enterable home doors (units) behind the flats' real doors. unitId is the door id: flat:<buildingInstanceId>:<doorIndex> (doorIndex 0-based within the building). tier is basement | flat | penthouse; roomType is the interior the client streams (e.g. apartment_modern). capacity is the most people living there (owner plus guests). weeklyRentCents is the catalog rent shown for the unit; the rent charged is still set by the home kind. These six ids are placeholders for the six lg_midrise_flats buildings in the Residences district; the frontend replaces the file with its real door ids. A tier with no units here keeps the old unit-less behaviour: leases succeed and the home has no door. The API upserts this file into home_units (a unit dropped from the file stays in the table, so a leased door is never pulled from under a tenant).
